note: Boss unlock goals (opt-in). OFF by default: bossGoalsEnabledDefault is false and the page turns them on only with ?bossgoals=1 (startSwitch). With the flag off nothing here reads or changes the game: every area boss stands in its pocket as before. On, each listed boss is not placed when its area is set up; the kills that count (counts: resident = a placed resident, wave = a ?waves=1 wave mob, hunter = a marked or raid hunter; never a boss) made in that boss's own area fill a counter, shown as a ring on the HUD, and the boss steps in beside the player when it is full. Progress is session state on the live game (never saved, never sent); a reload starts it again. engine/boss-goal-core.js is the pure part (switch, lock, count), engine/boss-goals.js the step, engine/boss-goal-view.js the ring. A goal's lines are the webText.json ids bossGoal.<id>.hud (the ring's label) and bossGoal.<id>.arrive (the announcement and the banner).
note2: kills must stay below the area's living residents (a placed boss area holds 8 to 9 others, the Westminster tutorial 7 and never respawns them), so a goal can be met with no waves at all; with ?waves=1 it fills much faster.
